verdict.rationale: Windmill publishes a first-party OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, served live and versioned in the repo, with a hosted Scalar reference. It also documents a CLI, Git sync, and code/YAML definitions for flows, so programmatic access is clearly extensive. No evidence states that the API covers everything the UI can do, and the probe-3 404s were on marketing-site paths, not the live app spec, so parity is unproven rather than contradicted. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of full UI/API parity, coverage of UI-only areas such as the low-code app editor via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Windmill's cloud instance serves its OpenAPI 3.0.3 document live at /api/openapi.json (info title "Windmill API")
The source-of-truth spec lives in the official windmill-labs/windmill repository (backend/windmill-api/openapi.yaml), versioned with each release.
Windmill supports both UI-based operations via its webIDE and low-code builders, as well as CLI deployments from a Git repository
The Windmill CLI, `wmill` allows you to interact with Windmill instances right from your terminal.
